rules.name: Covenant
rules.text: Your gathering may only contain models with the Blood keyword.

leaderTrait.name: Chosen of the Hands
leaderTrait.text: When this gathering receives blood mana dice for its mana pool this model restores 2hp.

trait.name: March of the Hands
trait.text: On the first turn, before rolling for initiative, you may push this model 4″.
